import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """class,ha_2021,ha_2024,change_ha
water,24616,24499,-117.25
trees,2.4222e+05,2.1978e+05,-22444
mangrove,3364.9,3883.5,518.6
shrub and grass,56192,71786,15594
cropland,88241,85930,-2310.3
built,45176,53607,8431.2
bare,4507.5,4835.7,328.26
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_area(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 3.4))
    x = np.arange(len(df))
    ax.bar(x - 0.2, df.ha_2021 / 1000, 0.4, color="#9aa5b1", label="2021")
    ax.bar(x + 0.2, df.ha_2024 / 1000, 0.4, color="#2a78d6", label="2024 (same model)")
    ax.set_xticks(x, df["class"], rotation=20, ha="right", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Area (thousand ha)")
    ax.set_title("Lombok land cover, 2021 and 2024, one model", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    return fig

plot_area(df)
plt.show()
